brief.objective: Get the Bandit within 5 m of the Lady before t=240 s, or as close as possible, while keeping the Guard at least a few hundred metres away and never letting it reach 5 m. Score is lady_miss^2 + 1e6/(guard_min+0.1), so closing on the Lady dominates: staying 2600 m out costs about 6.8e6, while the Guard at 200 m costs only about 5e3.
brief.approach: Start at once, because 2600 m in 240 s needs about 11 m/s average. Thrust radially inward (negative x) to drop about 300-400 m below the Lady's orbit; a lower orbit also drifts forward. At the same time accelerate along-track toward the Lady at up to about 16 m/s, passing the Guard with that radial offset rather than through it. Use EVADE_GUARD only when the Guard is inside the keepout and closing; otherwise keep using APPROACH_LADY or GO_TO_WAYPOINT, because a Bandit at full speed and offset outruns a Guard capped near 12 m/s. Once past the Guard, glide down on the braking slope and finish slowly at the Lady, keeping enough fuel for a final BRAKE and for one more evasion.
phases: T0-20s: Burn hard along-track toward the Lady (+y) while thrusting radially inward to open a -300 to -400 m x offset from the Guard's line; waypoint about (-350, -900, 0).

20-110s: Bypass the Guard. Hold the radial offset and cruise at up to 16 m/s past the Guard. If the Guard is within 200 m and closing, use EVADE_GUARD (sidestep toward the Lady, never back toward the start), then resume the approach immediately.

110-200s: Once the Guard is behind or beside the Bandit, use APPROACH_LADY on the braking glide slope. Remove the radial offset gradually and keep closing speed under 16 m/s, dropping it as range falls.

Final 150 m: Slow the closing speed to about 2 m/s and close to under 5 m for the win. Use BRAKE only to stop an overshoot. If the Guard closes inside 100 m, take one short EVADE_GUARD jink and then re-approach.
Contingency: If fuel falls to the 15% reserve, stop chasing. Use APPROACH_LADY at low speed or COAST on a drifting approach, and save the remaining fuel for evasion.
